notes: Stabilization release for the 1.7 command-center UI. Removes remaining inherited blue/teal chrome by mapping legacy cyan/accent variables and preserved overlays to the approved dark-green/lime palette, including chat bubbles/actions, inline editing, attachments, project/live context, AI Search, command palette, preview resizing and artifact/overlay controls. Voice and Update no longer use fuzzy generic hidden-button routing: Update targets the proven #updateChip control directly, while Voice uses a dedicated offscreen rendered service island that preserves the original functional control and its handlers, with a legacy-root fallback if necessary. The clean 1.7.1 single-state Chat/Live architecture is retained, so no hidden legacy Chat/Live mode synchronization is reintroduced. The user-supplied green gear logo remains the visible A.C.E. branding. Regression capability checks confirmed attachments/document extraction/image vision, projects/history, AI Search, posters, presentations, Preview, downloads, Pocket TTS/voice, Stop, persistence and Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo research anchors remain present. Python, decompressed JavaScript, palette audit, logo hash, updater inputs and exact SHA-256 release hashes were verified from a fresh GitHub checkout before publication.
